items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: Rags Porter on trumpet... We still had Hudson, Big Jim, and Rags Porter.

ctx.x: Ah -- so the band went on through the early -- early part of '36, with Chester Lane and with the Hudson, Rags Porter on trumpet, and Sweets Swiss Edison. And shortly before the end of the '36 season, Sweets Swiss Edison left us.
